en: Colorized vintage postcard showing a crowded Main Street parade. Soldiers on horseback and marching infantry carrying an American flag move down the center of the street, flanked by dense crowds in early‑20th‑century clothing. Buildings on both sides display striped awnings and patriotic bunting. Handwritten or printed numbers appear at the top, and a printed caption at the bottom right reads "Street Scene, Oregon City, Oregon."
